<style>
    /* Custom CSS for card design */
    .custom-card {
      border: none;
      border-radius: 15px;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
      transition: transform 0.2s ease-in-out;
    }
  
    .custom-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
    }
  
    .custom-card img {
      max-height: 200px;
      object-fit: cover;
      border-top-left-radius: 15px;
      border-top-right-radius: 15px;
    }
  
    .custom-card .card-body {
      background-color: #fff;
    }
  
    .custom-card .card-title {
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      color: #333;
    }
  
    .custom-card .card-subtitle {
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      color: #666;
    }
  
    .custom-card .card-text {
      font-size: 1rem;
      color: #777;
    }
    .custom-jumbotron {
    background-color: #94aec8; /* Background color */
    padding: 40px; /* Padding inside the jumbotron */
    border-radius: 15px; /* Rounded corners */
    box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); /* Shadow */
  }

  .jumbotron-title {
    font-size: 2.5rem; /* Title font size */
    color: #333; /* Title color */
  }

  .jumbotron-description {
    font-size: 1.25rem; /* Description font size */
    color: #666; /* Description color */
  }
  </style>


<div class="container mt-5">
    <div class="row justify-content-center">
        <div class="col-md-6">
        <input type="text"  class="form-control align-items-center  justify-content-center" placeholder="First name" [(ngModel)]="searchtext">
        <br>
        </div>
        </div>
</div>

  <div class="">
  <div class="container">
<div class="row row-cols-1 row-cols-md-3">
     
  <div class="col mb-4" *ngFor="let item of books|searchfilter: searchtext | paginate: { itemsPerPage: count, currentPage: p, totalItems: books.length }">
    <div class="card custom-card">
      <img src="{{item.imageLink}}" class="card-img-top" alt="...">
      <div class="card-body">
        <h2 class="card-title">{{ item.title.toUpperCase() }}</h2>
        <h3 class="card-subtitle mb-2 text-muted">{{ item.country }}</h3>
        <h5 class="card-subtitle mb-2 text-muted">{{ item.author }}</h5>
        <p class="card-text">Publication Year: {{ item.year }}</p>
       
        <p class="card-text"> Price: PKR {{ item.pages }}</p><div class="text-center px-4"> <!-- Add padding with "px-4" class -->
            <a href="/details/{{item.id}}" class="btn btn-info btn-lg">Details</a>
            <button class="btn btn-primary btn-lg" (click)="addToCart(item)">Add to Cart</button>

          </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="text-center">
    <pagination-controls (pageChange)="p=$event"></pagination-controls>
  </div>


</div>
